stem.text: The diagram shows a Boltzmann distribution curve.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve with unlabelled axes: rises from the origin to a peak, then falls away; point X and point Y are marked on the vertical axis and E_A on the horizontal axis.

stem.text: Points X and Y are points on the vertical axis.
What is represented by both points X and Y?

B.text: number of molecules with energy equal to or greater than $E_\text{A}$; largest number of molecules with the same energy

C.text: number of molecules with energy equal to $E_\text{A}$; the amount of energy of the greatest number of molecules
